Rule.name: LDAP ApacheDS - Before Provisioning
Rule.Description: "groups" is an IIQ entitlement, not an LDAP attribute, so ApacheDS rejects it (NO_SUCH_ATTRIBUTE). This rule takes every "groups" change out of the LDAP request and stores it on the account request as arguments (hrGroupsAdd / hrGroupsRemove). The After Provisioning rule then applies them as uniqueMember changes on the groups.
